title: Riga Threshing Barn — Yasnaya Polyana
visualBrief: Complete independent medium-fi riga/threshing barn: higher braced log main room and inset lower attached bay, two closed red hipped metal roofs, three genuinely recessed boarded entrances, coarse log courses, pale timber vertical bracing, corner ends and supported low thresholds. Existing shared materials only; hidden exterior details are reconstructed. No copied photograph pixels, signage, exhibition contents, trees or people.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Public OpenStreetMap way167382241 explicitly names this footprint Рига and tags a one-story building with red roof. Retained PMTiles supplies the independent footprint. The museum exterior photograph shows a higher main log barn with lower attached bay, red hipped roofs, large boarded doors and vertical timber bracing. Native axes are baked east/up/south; the southwest end and southeast side facade assignments are inferred from the photograph and path context, not surveyed. The17.11x10.76m map rectangle generalizes the stepped plan. The photo-led main room and inset lower annex occupy only their individual footprints; the open entry recess keeps its original soil.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Photo-led main log wall3.35m/red hip ridge5.25m; lower annex wall2.6m/ridge3.78m above one level floor. The internal split, annex inset, door dimensions, bracing census and unseen rear remain reconstructed. Retained ground varies only0.23m across the footprint, so no sloped roof/floor adaptation is used. Floor0.2621166822335397m above outside datum and modest exposed plinth approximate native contact; no surveyed historical threshold claim.
